g.text: Bill request -> Payment -> explicit close (actual locks)
Same lock as Order/Payment/close. Later Orders ->409.
Repeated bill request keeps original timestamp; session remains ACTIVE.
payment transaction / same session row lock
require ACTIVE + billRequestedAt + no existing payment
insert PAID amount + paidAt; unique session_id
PAID does not close; duplicate Payment ->409.
If POST response lost, recover by GET; never auto-retry POST.
